hypothesis: The survey's fully-characterized bottleneck is signal MAGNITUDE vs the cost bar (within-regime AUC 0.53-0.55 cannot clear a 10bps taker roundtrip; the LGBM control's VAL gross edge was ~+9bps/trade vs 9bps account cost). Maker-first entry execution attacks the bar instead of the signal: post-only limit entries cut the roundtrip to ~7bps (2bps maker fee, no entry slippage, taker exit 5bps) and improve the entry price to the resting limit. On a ~1000-trade/4-month line, halving the entry-side cost is worth roughly 20-45pp of VAL PnL -- IF the fill-conditioned trade subset is not adversely selected. The ETH maker rejection (unfilled 10% were the runaway winners) applies to multi-day swing entries; the BTC Kappa1 fill audit showed 98% fill and ~-1bp adverse selection at high-frequency cadence, and this SOL line is the high-frequency case the 2026-08-07 memory explicitly reserves maker execution for.

research.prior_failure_reassessment: ETH maker-entry was REJECTED 2026-08-07 for the Omega4.6.1 swing router because at 63 entries the few unfilled trades were the +17-22% runaway winners -- a low-frequency, long-hold failure mode. The surviving half of the Kappa1 closure is precisely the maker fill audit methodology (conservative 1m strict trade-through, cross-at-open = no fill) and its finding that the cost bar halves at high frequency. This SOL line trades ~250-1000 times per 4-month split with <=24h holds: the regime where a missed fill costs one median trade, not a fat tail.
research.retest_design: Stage A+B in one pre-registered pass, frozen inputs: the saved unconditional LGBM control booster (no retraining), the same TB label TP/SL structure, and newly downloaded SOLUSDT 1m klines. For each of the 6 frozen entry rules: decisions on VAL, post-only limit at the decision 5m bar close, active from the next 1m bar, cross-at-open counted as NO FILL, filled only on strict 1m trade-through within a 15-minute cancel window, no queue-position credit. Filled trades enter at the limit price and run TP/SL (2.5/1.2 sigma from the limit) bar-by-bar on 1m data, 1440-minute horizon, SL checked before TP, non-overlapping. Cost: 7bps roundtrip (2 maker + 5 taker-exit) vs the taker baseline's 10. Metrics recorded per rule: fill rate, maker VAL PnL, and the taker-counterfactual PnL of UNFILLED entries (the adverse-selection number). VAL selection needs PnL > 0, >=15 trades, >=3/4 months positive; ONE OOS read of the selected rule; adoption requires OOS PnL > 0. A VAL fill rate < 50% or unfilled-counterfactual strongly positive (ETH failure shape) is an explicit kill signal regardless of PnL.

model.candidate_architecture: FROZEN unconditional LGBM control + maker-first post-only entry execution (1m strict trade-through fill simulation, 15-minute cancel, 7bps roundtrip)

selection.validation_pass_criteria: selected rule must have maker VAL PnL > 0 with >=15 trades and >=3/4 VAL months positive; VAL fill rate < 50% or strongly-positive unfilled-counterfactual kills the line regardless of PnL; single OOS read; adoption requires OOS PnL > 0
